events.strFilename: Boxing 2026-11-06 Paul Gallen vs Nelson Asofa-Solomona
events.strDescriptionEN: Paul Gallen comes out of retirement to face unbeaten former NRL rival Nelson Asofa-Solomona in a five-round heavyweight clash in Sydney. Gallen brings far greater boxing experience, while Asofa-Solomona enters with a significant size advantage and a perfect knockout record. The crossover matchup carries major domestic interest despite having no championship at stake.
events.strResult: Nelson Asofa-Solomona stopped Paul Gallen in the opening round of their heavyweight clash in Sydney. The unbeaten heavyweight overwhelmed Gallen with a powerful combination late in the round, forcing the fight to be stopped after a decisive knockdown. The victory moved Asofa-Solomona to 4-0 as a professional and marked a dramatic end to Gallen’s comeback.
